caption: The drawing depicts a metal teapot rendered in shades of dark gray and black, showing areas of wear and patina. The teapot has a cylindrical body that tapers outward towards the base, a curved handle attached on the left side, and an elongated, curved spout on the right. The lid is domed with a small knob on top and displays painted decorations consisting of green leaves and small red berries. The main body also features decorative hand-painted motifs, with two red-orange fruits surrounded by green leaves and yellow highlights, and some floral or vine-like embellishments. Below the teapot, there is a line of text that reads, “Drawn to actual size - Elmer G. Anderson -” written in a stylized font. The background is a plain, light tan or off-white color without any additional objects.
title: Toleware Tin Coffee Pot
